g.text: Floor +2.55 m. Nominal clear height 2.12 m. Room sizes
give the bounding spans in metres.
The lift opens aft into the boot lobby. Two window divans form the passenger majlis forward. The crew bunk and
compact coffee galley flank the landing, so nobody sleeps beside the loading rail.
